query: Why do some travel expenses get declined, and which factors contribute the most?

per_column.name: is_travel
per_column.rationale: Directly relevant flag for isolating travel expenses, the core subject of the query. Derivable from category/short_description; sample rows are non-travel and correctly marked 0.

per_column.name: has_source_id
per_column.rationale: Trivially derived presence flag from source_id. Weak analytical leverage for explaining declines; largely a data-completeness indicator. Values are directly grounded.

per_column.name: is_unfinalized
per_column.rationale: Process-state flag could correlate with declines, giving some analytical value. Grounded—nan processed_date row correctly flagged unfinalized.

per_column.name: amount_range
per_column.rationale: Bucketing amount is a genuine grouping axis; expense size is a plausible decline driver. Derived from amount column, though bucket thresholds are unverifiable from samples.

per_column.name: has_processed_date
per_column.rationale: Bare presence flag largely redundant with is_unfinalized and days_to_process (-1 sentinel). Grounded but adds little independent leverage.

per_column.name: days_to_process
per_column.rationale: Processing duration is a meaningful continuous factor for modeling declines. Uses -1 sentinel for missing dates appropriately. Requires opened_at, which is present; values appear plausible.

per_column.name: is_cust_support_travel
per_column.rationale: A more specific travel sub-category offers a finer grouping axis relevant to the query. Derivable from department/category+description; samples are 0, consistent, but specificity is harder to verify.

judge.rationale: Several columns (is_travel, amount_range, days_to_process, is_cust_support_travel, is_unfinalized) provide genuine grouping/modeling axes for explaining declines. A few (has_source_id, has_processed_date) are near-trivial presence flags with weak leverage and some redundancy with the duration/finalization columns. Groundedness is generally strong: values in the samples are sound readings of the source text, missing dates are handled with sentinels rather than invented facts, and no clear hallucinations are observed; only the bucket thresholds and sub-category specificity are not fully verifiable from the provided samples.
